label: ercot49 offer retune tempderate
definition: Offer-curve re-derivation under temp_dependent_derate (rule 1: keep the physical derate, re-derive the offer LEVEL): ercot46_clock_steamgas config + temp derate, with the keeper's fitted scarcity walls stripped to physically-grounded values -- CC_REGULAR peak 4.58->2.25 (F-class duct-burner ratio), CC_REGULAR/CC_CHP econ_high ->1.27 (CAMPD CC marginal-HR reach), CT_PEAKER peak 13.15->4.0 (de-fits the encoded $5,000 ORDC wall the multiproduct co-opt now prices endogenously), ST_GAS peak 3.2->2.2; committed/econ_low bands unchanged. A/B vs ercot48-tempderate-full-probe (identical config, keeper curves): C3a mean-LMP error +269/+161/+42% -> +264/+156/+36%, C3b NRMSE 4.50/2.91/0.62 -> 4.42/2.85/0.56, C3c tail 328/100/42 h vs DA actual 311/68/23 (PASS all years) -- the offer top-of-stack is INERT on the temp-derate C3a/C3b blow-out. Diagnosis (2023): the overshoot is ~210 reserve-shortfall hours priced $1,000-5,000 by the co-opt ORDC steps plus 65 load-shed hours at VOLL (~$8.9k, mean 1.2 GW slack), not offer-set; measured telemetry contradicts the modeled scarcity -- median RTOLCAP in those model-deep hours was 6.9 GW (RTORPA $13.8) / 8.3 GW (RTORPA $0.3): the availability stack under temp derate sits ~5-7 GW below the real system's measured online capability in the scarcity window. Offer re-tuning cannot (and per rule 1 must not) close this; root cause is the hot-hour availability level vs measured RTOLHSL/RTOLCAP. PROBE, not a promotion; keeper stays ercot46. || REJECTED WITH CAUSE (owner decision 2026-07-09): the temp-derate line is closed for ERCOT. Cause: the fleet's own measured behaviour refutes the literature slopes — scarcity-hour (RT>$200) capability slope fitted above 34C is ~0 or negative for every gas class (CC -0.27, CT -0.04, ST_GAS -0.29, CC_CHP -1.41 %/degC vs model +0.76/+1.26/+0.54; online CT p90 = 1.00-1.02x rating in every bin 30-46C), production at TMAX>=40C reached 95-100%+ of net-summer rating for most capacity, and telemetered RTOLCAP showed 6.9-8.3 GW spare in the model's deep hours (scripts/probes/_ercot_temp_capability_envelope.py; calibration-log 2026-07-09). The measured ERCOT parameterization is slope~0 above rating = the keeper's flat net-summer treatment. Keeper stays 2026-07-08-ercot46-clock-steamgas; the thin-tail miss routes to the measured DAM offer-surface path (G-22 SS5.1 / ercot37 SS8).
